latest.title: Bypassing Cloudflare for True Origin Health Checks with Blackbox Exporter and CoreDNS
latest.description: When Cloudflare masks origin failures, your health checks lie to you. A CoreDNS sidecar that overrides DNS resolution lets Blackbox Exporter probe origins directly while keeping TLS and Host headers intact.

latest.title: Como se encontrar na tecnologia através da Cloud Computing
latest.description:
Entrar no mundo da tecnologia pode ser empolgante… mas também extremamente confuso.
São muitas áreas, muitas linguagens, muitas possibilidades, front-end, back-end, dados, segurança, mobile, IA… e no meio disso tudo, uma dúvida constante:
“Será que eu estou no caminho certo?”
Se você já se sentiu assim, saiba que isso é mais comum do que parece.

latest.title: Achieving an Agentic Back-Office in Manufacturing: A Prescriptive Guide to 5–10X Productivity Gains
latest.description: Manufacturing back-office operations consume 1.5%–5.0% of total revenue in manual transactional processing — from hand-keying invoices to reconciling inventory in spreadsheets. This prescriptive guide shows you exactly where to deploy Agentic AI across five critical mega-processes to achieve 5–10X productivity gains, with a clear risk-value framework, AWS services to get started, and production-ready partner platforms already delivering results.

latest.description: Running 100k+ tenants on a single EKS cluster is not a larger version of running 100 — it's a different problem entirely.
